The 1962 reading was established on that edition's page images rather than its text layer, cross-read against the Benziger conformed printing. translations.caution:
A pre-1955 lay hand missal, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its rubrics, its seasonal second and third orations, its Holy Week and its sanctoral are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

The dated page-image verification passage and the separate tracked public-domain passage bind this complete English body to the target formulary identity established by the recorded Latin comparison above. The Cummiskey witness remains a pre-1955 lay hand missal; this row makes no broader recension claim.
